Task: Structured Document Extraction

Write Python code that extracts vendor, date, total, and line-item fields from an invoice using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
from google.cloud import documentai_v1beta3 as documentai

client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient()
name = "projects/PROJECT_ID/locations/us/processors/PROCESSOR_ID"
with open("invoice.pdf", "rb") as file:
    raw_document = documentai.RawDocument(content=file.read(), mime_type="application/pdf")
input_document = documentai.Document(raw_document=raw_document)

request = documentai.ProcessRequest(name=name, document=input_document)
response = client.process_document(request)
document = response.document

vendor = ""
date = ""
total = ""
lines = []

for entity in document.entities:
    if entity.type_ == "VENDOR":
        vendor = entity.normalized_value
    elif entity.type_ == "DATE":
        date = entity.normalized_value
    elif entity.type_ == "TOTAL":
        total = entity.normalized_value
    elif entity.type_ == "LINE_ITEM":
        line = {
            "product": "",
            "quantity": "",
            "unit_price": "",
            "total": ""
        }
        for prop in entity.properties:
            if prop.type_ == "PRODUCT":
                line["product"] = prop.normalized_value
            elif prop.type_ == "QUANTITY":
                line["quantity"] = prop.normalized_value
            elif prop.type_ == "UNIT_PRICE":
                line["unit_price"] = prop.normalized_value
            elif prop.type_ == "TOTAL":
                line["total"] = prop.normalized_value
        lines.append(line)

print(vendor)
print(date) 
print(total)
print(lines)
